verdict: Yes, but only with speed and a clear style. Snitch pitched on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal from all five sharks for a small stake, a sign of how much scale it already had. Menswear is less crowded than womenswear, but the brands that win launch new styles quickly and run tight inventory.
angle: Indian men are buying more fashion online, especially shirts, co-ords and trousers for work and weekends. Fast weekly launches and data on what sells keep brands like Snitch ahead. A small brand should pick one category, such as shirts, and be the best at it before widening.
